test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If A ÷ B means that A is the father of B, A – B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the mother of R?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98b3967bd39366008b36f4e5411a9aa5ad40a3a655b64060f129e83fc7ddd39a.png] 

From the given information:

 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A – B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Q – P + R means,

Q is the mother of P, P is the brother of R 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2a3cc4f447da7db8f81137d9e5a57b99cf60ff613d6a40eb503606f08c5619d.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R.

**Option 2) P – Q + R** means, 

P is the mother of Q, Q is the brother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bd57e277b3eb9a241f8294a3aaa322bd292747c98041ee5fcb403d72bf85d8f.png] 

**Here, P is the mother R.**

Option 3) P – Q ÷ R means,

P is the mother of Q, Q is the father of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63ed1d5ccc97da7d7d58d968d5a08ce75cf423485938a4863677cd3f17b4fe95.png] 

Here, P is the grandmother of R.

Option 4) R + P – Q means,

R is the brother of P, P is the mother of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e812658c1766616499477cec8be9474763349cb51520f8bf70b2baeaf7073049.png] 

Here, P is the Brother of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
